metadata.scope: LM-series rod carriages, MGN rail adapter plates, V-slot wheel plates, smooth-rod end holders.

material_suggestions.use_case: machined carriage plates for CNC and robotics
material_suggestions.notes: Rigid; bore rod holes to H7 for tight LM bearing fit.
Lower creep than PLA; add metal rod inserts for bore accuracy.
Acceptable for light-duty; bore may wear over time.

standards_used.name: LM-series linear bearing standard
standards_used.note: LM8UU: bore 8 mm, OD 15 mm, length 24 mm. Housing bore = OD + 0.0/+0.05 mm transition fit.

standards_used.name: MGN12H carriage footprint
standards_used.note: MGN12H: 33×27 mm, 4×M3 holes on 20×20 mm pattern.

output_policy.openscad_code: Geometry-only OpenSCAD with named parameters, one module, and no prose.

parts.name: Dual LM8UU rod carriage

rod_spacing.note: must match printer or CNC frame

main_features: two parallel rod bores along travel axis
mounting holes on top face for payload
optional nut pocket for lead screw if combined with actuator
design_rules: rod bores horizontal along X axis, symmetric about Y=0 at rod_spacing/2
mounting holes on top face in symmetric grid
validation_criteria: two rod bores parallel in difference
failure_modes: single rod bore instead of two

constraint_checks.message: Dual-rod carriage needs two parallel rod bores.
